hooks.name: Keep V2 spec in sync
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to keep the V2 spec, README and UI ecosystem list in sync when ecosystem or publishing code changes. Cheap: no build is run.

action.prompt: A V2 ecosystem or publishing file changed. If behaviour changed, update .kiro/specs/reporevive-v2/{requirements,design,tasks}.md first (tick completed tasks, record new limits), and keep README.md "Supported ecosystems" and src/lib/ecosystems.ts consistent: an ecosystem is advertised only when its detector, runtime, plan, diagnoser, strategies and tests exist.
